ca_stirrup_tank.name: Stirrup Tank
ca_stirrup_tank.note: Sources speak for Joshua Tree NP as a whole, none names Stirrup Tank: one lists Sep-May, others mid-Oct to late Apr/May; shared window Oct-Apr taken. Summer is an oven. Pinto Basin is low desert so the shoulders are the hot end.

co_poudre_canyon.name: Poudre Canyon
co_poudre_canyon.note: Mountain Project bouldering text says late spring through early fall; Adventure Collective (Timnath) says spring and fall; CMC lists Lower Poudre as year-round. Sources conflict and no month-naming source; sunny winter days also climb.

ia_pictured_rocks.name: Pictured Rocks
ia_pictured_rocks.note: MP says busy on fall and spring weekends, shade in summer; gate locked in winter. Season words only, no months.

mt_allenspur.name: Allenspur
mt_allenspur.note: Outside Bozeman: finest early-season crag, spring sun; MP: milder than Gallatin Valley, longer rock season, occasional winter days; Anker says good through fall. No months named.

or_rattlesnake.name: Rattlesnake
or_rattlesnake.note: Rogue Valley Rattlesnake crag (near Shady Cove, not Grants Pass); MP: best spring and fall, possible all year; Medford guide: April-May most popular. Season words only.

va_forest_the.name: Forest, The
va_forest_the.note: No source found for this crag; only Humpback Rocks hiking pages (a different place), which do not count.

bc_kinnaird_bluffs.name: Kinnaird Bluffs
bc_kinnaird_bluffs.note: No source found naming a season; MP chart did not render.

ca_phantom_spires.name: Phantom Spires
ca_phantom_spires.note: Lover's Leap Guides: spires cut off by winter snow, sunny winter climbing noted, spring recommended for low crowds. No months named; Lover's Leap May-Oct window is a different crag.

ma_sector_two.name: Sector Two
ma_sector_two.note: Lynn Woods/Promised Land pages name no season; MP chart did not render.

mt_natural_bridge_and_falls.name: Natural Bridge and Falls
mt_natural_bridge_and_falls.note: MP guide says spring and fall best, summer river dips; Forest Service road open all year. Season words only.

nm_last_chance_canyon.name: Last Chance Canyon
nm_last_chance_canyon.note: Summitpost lists spring, fall, winter; a guide says summer too hot, fall/winter/spring prime; another says year round. Season words only, no months.

ny_p_east_end.name: East End
ny_p_east_end.note: Powerlinez pages name no season; MP chart did not render.

ri_beach_pond.name: Beach Pond
ri_beach_pond.note: No source names a season; MP chart did not render.

az_atlantis.name: Atlantis
az_atlantis.note: Queen Creek Canyon: rockclimbing.com 'When to climb: winter' only; no month-naming source.

az_upper_sullivan_s.name: Upper Sullivan's
az_upper_sullivan_s.note: Only Granite Dells/Prescott generic pages (spring and fall best, or year-round by shade); nothing for Sullivan's Canyon.

ca_main_formation.name: Main Formation
ca_main_formation.note: Lover's Leap Guides: season typically May through October; Alpine Skills: early May through October. Both guide services; fall seen as peak. Peregrine closure Apr 21-Sep 30 affects some routes only.

id_mccall_area.name: McCall Area
id_mccall_area.note: MP and Shore Lodge: May to late September; Visit McCall: June until first snowfall. Shared window May-Sep taken.

id_massacre_rocks_state_park.name: Massacre Rocks State Park
id_massacre_rocks_state_park.note: MP: fall and spring best, summer too hot, sunny winter days fine; climb-idaho names Mar-May and Sep-Nov. BLM portion closed to climbing since Aug 2023.
